    The residual quotient-group shift #

    For N ◁ G, the chosen G / N-representative translations of the N-shift-orbit category satisfy the two unit laws and associativity. They therefore define a coherent shift indexed by Additive (G / N).

    The proofs use the canonical-path formulas from ShiftOrbitResidualTranslate. Faithful inclusion into the full G-orbit category reduces every coherence equation to cancellation of object-shift isomorphisms and dependent congruence along a quotient-group law.
